integration_notes: Copy only the numeric .glb files into your game asset folder. All images are embedded.
Configure GLTFLoader with DRACOLoader; local decoder files from three/examples/jsm/libs/draco/gltf are recommended. These assets also require EXT_texture_webp, supported by modern browsers.
Preserve imported node transforms. Apply corrections in an outer group: Pikachu 25 X=-PI/2, Flareon 136 Y=+PI/2. The other 13 need no base correction for a +Z facing convention.
Use SkeletonUtils.clone for repeated model instances because these GLBs contain skins.

After correcting orientation and updating world matrices, compute a skinned Box3; scale by targetHeight / size.y and translate horizontal center to zero and min.y to ground. Avoid normalizing by longest dimension: long tails shrink Raichu and Charizard excessively.

Animation selection should be deliberate: Charizard has a dizzy clip and Pikachu a thunder-shock clip; they are not neutral idle animations. Static models can receive gentle whole-body bob/turn movement.
